paragraphs.text: Kolevi of Havenwood was an Elder Druid from Havenwood on Dominaria .

Kolevi was an Elder Druid of Havenwood. He was quite old around 170 AR . Going up the stairs to his lover, fellow Elder Druid Lalani , forced him to take several breaks as he became easily winded. He and Lalani shared the secret of Thelon 's success with the thallids - they were made in part from thrulls from the Ebon Hand . The thrulls were obtained through trade with the Ebon Hand, which happened on the western border of Icatian lands. To distract Icatia from this illicit trade, the Havenwood druids had ordered Reod Dai to set up raids and skirmishes in the southern reaches of Icatia, near the Crimson Peaks .
